mentions.name: Raze
mentions.description: A web application that converts form-fillable PDFs into full interactive TTRPG character sheets, featuring 3D dice rolling and configurable, reusable rolls. It is described as something like D&D Beyond but for indie games.
mentions.audience: Players of indie tabletop role-playing games
mentions.source_excerpt: Working on an web application to turn form fillable PDF's into full interactive TTRPG character sheets, with 3d dice rolling, configurable / re-usable rolls, etc...
